title: Unlocking Global Reach and Explosive Growth
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner declares a global mandate for The River Church of Kansas City, prophesying an explosion of growth, influence, and impact in the next three years. Join Pastor Zehner as he leads the church in a bold declaration of faith, calling forth open doors, increased finances, and multiplied ministry to the nations. This message will challenge and inspire you to believe for the impossible and see the church thrive in the mighty name of Jesus.
